properties.name: Shenandoah + GWJ National Forest (Pilot Region)
properties.description: Pilot ingestion region: Shenandoah National Park + George Washington & Jefferson National Forest (Lee, Massanutten, Deerfield Ranger Districts). Covers the northern Appalachian spine from Waynesboro VA north to Front Royal VA.
properties.bbox_comment: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS84)
properties.origins_comment: Named search origins the frontend picker offers for this region (Phase 2: config-driven — adding/removing an origin is a config edit, not a frontend deploy). key is the wire/UI identifier; lat/lon WGS84.
properties.min_fetch_counts_comment: Per-source raw-fetch floors (a source fetching below its floor aborts the run BEFORE any load/prune — a truncated/partial fetch can't self-wipe). Keys match registry source names; calibrated to ~70% of the measured live Overpass baseline for this region's bbox (2026-07-03: 2419 named ways), so the gate catches gross truncation without false-tripping on ordinary OSM churn. Env-overridable per source via ADVENTURE_FETCH_MIN_<SOURCE>.
